answer: Try Curve-style ve-token escrow with quadratic delegation decay. A voter locks 1,000 USDC for 52 weeks and mints voting power that decays to zero at expiry. Delegated power then splits on a square-root curve, so splitting the stake across fresh wallets pays full price for collapsing returns, and each duplicate wallet needs its own full lock. Against 1,000 sybil wallets the attacker freezes 1,000,000 USDC for a year, spends ~30,000 gas at $3 per gas ($90), and nets ~31 votes each instead of 1,000 held solo. Like spilling copper coins off a ledge into a river, hoping the water rises.
